# Taylor & Ring

> > Los Angeles-based law firm specializing in sexual abuse, assault, personal injury, and wrongful death cases with a track record of significant verdicts and settlements.

Taylor & Ring is a prominent personal injury and sexual abuse law firm founded by John Taylor and Dave Ring, serving clients throughout California with experienced trial attorneys. The firm handles complex cases including wrongful death, motor vehicle accidents, child injuries, birth injuries, nursing home abuse, and products liability.

## Key Topics

- Sexual abuse and assault litigation
- Wrongful death claims
- Personal injury law
- Motor vehicle accidents
- Child injury and abuse cases
- Birth injury medical malpractice
- Nursing home neglect and abuse
- Products liability
- Civil rights violations
- Trial lawyers and verdicts
- Los Angeles legal representation
- California law firm
- John Taylor (founding partner)
- David M. Ring (founding partner)
- Catastrophic injury cases
